summary: Well‑executed, preregistered paired confirmatory study with full archived artifacts that produced a null (ceiling) result under shared_initial_candidate semantics. The run appears faithful to the preregistration and the manuscript correctly interprets the null outcome and its methodological implications. However, the submitted manuscript contains two substantive publication‑format/provenance problems that must be fixed before finalisation: (1) the References section is not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full bibliographic metadata for each cited work, and (2) the manuscript embeds run‑internal file paths and SHA‑256 digests (other than the single required master_prompt reference), which violates the track’s Disclosure/provenance rules. These are blocking issues but are resolvable from the archived evidence bundle without new experiments.
critical_issues: References are not a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full bibliographic metadata; several entries use bare DOIs/arXiv identifiers or incomplete venue metadata rather than author/title/venue/year records. This prevents independent verification that each cited work supports the claims.

Manuscript prose and Disclosure include run‑internal artifact paths and multiple SHA‑256 digests (e.g., execution/model_configuration.json SHA‑256 and other per‑file hashes). Per the track rules, only the immutable initial master‑prompt locator and its SHA‑256 digest are permitted in manuscript prose; other per‑file hashes/paths must be removed from the manuscript and Disclosure (they may remain in the archived evidence bundle).
required_revisions: Replace the References section with a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography giving complete bibliographic metadata (authors, full title, venue/proceedings or repository, year, and page or article identifiers where available) for every cited record. Do not present DOI or arXiv identifiers alone as the bibliographic entry when full metadata is available. Ensure each in‑text IEEE citation number matches the corresponding full reference entry and that every claim citing prior work is supported by the referenced record (use the archived verified reference metadata to construct the entries). This revision may be completed using the supplied verified bibliography record/artifacts.

Remove all run‑internal file paths and SHA‑256 digests from the manuscript body and from the Disclosure Statement except for exactly one immutable master‑prompt locator and its associated SHA‑256 digest (provenance/master_prompt.txt and its digest). Replace explicit per‑file manifest paths and hashes with a concise statement that the full execution manifest, raw results, validator traces, and analysis artifacts are archived and available at the archived evidence bundle (cite the archived bundle identifier or manifest in the repository metadata if needed), but do not print per‑file paths or digests in the manuscript. This revision is resolvable from the archived artifacts.

Ensure Methods explicitly state the preregistered generation_semantics = shared_initial_candidate and note (briefly) that the archived model configuration recorded temperature = null/unset and that null/unset does not imply deterministic model sampling. If the manuscript currently repeats specific per‑file hashes to justify this statement, remove the hashes and instead reference the archived artifact bundle (without embedding its internal paths or digests).
optional_revisions: If archived validator‑audit artifacts exist in the evidence bundle (for example, the planned seeded 100‑case validator audit or other audit traces), summarise that audit briefly (sensitivity/specificity) in Methods or Limitations to better justify claims about validator construct validity; if such artifacts are absent, state that an independent validator sensitivity audit was preregistered but not executed and flag it as future work (do not require new experiments).

Add a very short clarification (one sentence) explaining why model_calls_used = 600 (one shared initial generation per pair) differs from maximum_model_calls = 1200 (the preregistered upper bound), to avoid reader confusion; this can reference the shared_initial_candidate contract without including internal paths or hashes.

Polish the References to ensure each bibliographic entry includes a persistent identifier (DOI or arXiv id) as a supplemental field but not as the sole bibliographic metadata; include publisher/venue and year consistently to improve reader traceability.
